about_the_game:
Holyland is a roguelike deck-building adventure game that delivers a dark adventure with the thrilling satisfaction of synergies.

Break the Game with Various Strategies

All weapons and artifacts hold potential. But it's up to you to unleash that potential!

From choosing which area to enter to deciding which shop to reroll in, when your strategy shines, thrilling power will properly reward you.

  • 52 artifacts and 4 special artifacts

  • 55 weapons and 4 special weapons

  • The "Transform" system that grants special powers

  • Various strategies - single-concept decks and hybrid decks, reroll decks and single-weapon decks, etc. All possibilities are open.

  • You might even be able to clear the game without any weapons.

Not Just a "Player", but a "Character"

Why can you start over from the beginning when you die? Why must you explore the dungeon?

In Holyland, there are no adventures without reason. Uncover the secrets through various event scenarios.

Immersive events tailored to each floor unfold across 7 total floors.

This dark dungeon will tighten its grip on you even more, and within it, you must find the most beneficial choices.

  • At least 3 unique events per floor

  • Remove weapons, increase stats... you can even "Transform" into another being.

  • Events are continuously updated.

  • When officially released, an enhanced story will reveal all secrets and you will face the Saint.

The Dungeon Keeps Moving

Holyland is a game in development. Through continuous updates, all elements of the game will be added or modified, and every update will aim solely at the fun you experience.

  • Weapons, artifacts, events, and transforms continue to be added.

  • The secrets of the dungeon surrounding you will be revealed through added story content.

  • New characters will deliver completely new combat experiences with entirely new weapons and artifacts.

  • If you find any bugs or have feedback for us, it would be a great help! Please use our Discord channel!

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon HD 5570

Recommended:

short_description: Holyland is a roguelike deck-building adventure game. Combine suitable weapons and relics to create a powerful deck, defeat enemies, and advance toward the heart of the dungeon. Uncover the secrets of the dungeon and the saint who has trapped you within it.
supported_languages: English, Korean, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
